plan.rationale: Best is attempt-09 (64x128x32,s2,t128,sw16) at 399.54us, a real improvement over the prior 462.42us sweet spot; it shares tile/stage/thread with attempt-04/06 (sw64/sw32 at 462.4-462.5us) so swizzle=16 is the differentiator despite invariant 16.78MB simulated DRAM — the analytic traffic feature does not capture it, so keep traffic=1, pipeline=1.5, footprint=0.5. Threads=64 (654.98us) and 256 (474.98us) regressed, so fix threads=[128]. stages=3 regressed at 64x64 (524.35us); keep num_stages=[2,3] but bias toward s2. Narrow block_N to [128] and swizzle to mid-range [8,16,32] around the winner to isolate whether sw16 or larger block_M is the driver; keep block_M=[64,128] and block_K=[32,64] to test the still-unmeasured block_M=128 / block_K=64 hypotheses. Next hypothesis: 128x128x32 or block_K=64 at stages=2 with swizzle 8-32 lowers latency below 399.54us. Scope: Metal executes exact source/config/TIR; GB10 values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements; no global optimality claimed.
